title: SeaWorld Orlando Welcomes Orphaned Pacific Walrus Calf Rescued in Alaska to New Home
summary: SeaWorld Orlando Welcomes Orphaned Pacific Walrus Calf Rescued in Alaska to New Home
body_text: ORLANDO, Fla. ( Sept 25, 2024) – SeaWorld Orlando is grateful to welcome a rare rescued Pacific walrus calf from the Alaska SeaLife Center (ASLC), now under the expert care of SeaWorld Orlando’s renowned animal care specialists. The calf, which was found orphaned and abandoned on the beaches of Utqiagvik, Alaska, has been named Ukiaq , which translates to “autumn” in the language of the Iñupiaq people who live in the area of northern Alaska where she was first found. Ukiaq – or Uki (pronounced “oo-kee”) as she is affectionately being called – brings the Alaskan spirit with her to Orlando, honoring the rich culture and traditions of the Alaskan Native peoples. After receiving life-saving rehabilitative care from the ASLC and being deemed non-releasable by the United States Fish & Wildlife Service (USFWS), Uki arrived at her long-term home SeaWorld Orlando on September 18, weighing approximately 220 pounds and ready to continue her care. SeaWorld Orlando was chosen as Uki’s new home because of the staff’s experience with walrus care, and the overall walrus herd at SeaWorld Orlando allows for the best nurturing environment for her overall care and development, including a female walrus that is capable of acting as a surrogate to Uki. The specialized care Uki is receiving at SeaWorld is part of the park’s long-standing commitment to wildlife rescue and rehabilitation. SeaWorld’s animal care specialists are working closely with veterinarians to ensure Uki’s needs continue to be met, including a carefully crafted feeding plan and ongoing medical evaluations. While Uki’s arrival is a heartwarming milestone, she will not be introduced to SeaWorld Orlando’s guest-facing habitats immediately. The young walrus will spend time acclimating to her new surroundings and receiving the round-the-clock care necessary to support her growth and well-being. “Uki’s journey to SeaWorld Orlando is only the beginning of her new chapter. Our team is providing dedicated, 24/7 care to ensure her transition is as smooth as possible,” said Dr. Joseph Gaspard, Vice President of Zoological Operations at SeaWorld Orlando. “We want to give her time to settle into her new home, and once she’s ready, guests will have the unique opportunity to meet this extraordinary calf and learn more about our conservation efforts in the Arctic region.” Uki was first discovered by Utqiagvik community members in July 2024, after a walrus herd had left the area. Alone and vulnerable, the young calf, estimated to be only a few weeks old, was transported to the Alaska SeaLife Center (ASLC) in a rescue operation in coordination with the United States Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS). She received immediate medical care for dehydration and malnourishment from the Alaska SeaLife Center’s expert team, and additional professionals familiar with walrus care, including SeaWorld, mobilized to provide additional support for her round-the-clock care. “We are proud to have been able to quickly respond to the call for help, getting a zoological team with expertise in walrus care to the Alaska SeaLife Center within 24 hours of the calf’s rescue,” said Dr. Claire Erlacher-Reid, Senior Veterinarian at SeaWorld Orlando. “Uki’s story of survival is a testament to the importance of partnerships and rapid response in wildlife rescue, and we are committed to providing her with the highest level of care as she continues her journey here at SeaWorld Orlando.” "We are thrilled by the progress this walrus calf has made since her admission to the Alaska SeaLife Center Wildlife Response Program. As just the eleventh orphaned Pacific walrus calf to come through our doors since our opening 25 years ago, we recognize how incredibly special she is. Success stories like Ukiaq is what inspires us, the only organization authorized to rehabilitate live-stranded marine mammals in the state of Alaska," said Dr. Wei Ying Wong, ASLC President and CEO. Uki’s story of survival continues to highlight the importance of global collaboration in marine mammal rescue. “From the Utqiagvik community members who first found her, to the tireless efforts of the ASLC team, and now to our family here at SeaWorld Orlando, Uki has been surrounded by people committed to giving her a second chance,” said Dr. Gaspard. As she grows stronger in her new home, Uki will play an essential role as an ambassador for her species, educating the public on the challenges Pacific walruses face in the wild. Her story, like many other animals rescued by SeaWorld Orlando, emphasizes the park’s ongoing mission to inspire action toward the protection and preservation of marine life. About SeaWorld SeaWorld is a leading marine life theme park and accredited zoo and aquarium that provides experiences that matter while educating and inspiring guests of all ages to care about marine life. Welcoming millions of guests every year, the parks offer fun and enriching experiences from up-close animal encounters and year-round educational programs to award-winning marine-life-themed rides and attractions, special events, and exciting entertainment. For more than 60 years SeaWorld has advanced the conservation of marine life in and outside its parks through science, education, and exceptional animal care that is Humane Certified by American Humane and accredited by the Alliance of Marine Mammal Parks and Aquariums and the Association of Zoos and Aquariums. SeaWorld is one of the largest marine animal rescue organizations in the world, helping more than 41,000 animals to date. The SeaWorld Conservation Fund, a non-profit foundation established in 2003, has provided more than $20 million to nearly 1,400 organizations to advance critical research on every continent. A portion of park proceeds goes toward supporting these longstanding conservation commitments. SeaWorld parks are in Orlando, San Antonio, San Diego, and Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates (UAE). SeaWorld is part of the United Parks & Resorts Inc. (NYSE:PRKS) portfolio of theme park brands. For more information, visit us at SeaWorld.com. About ASLC Opened in 1998, the Alaska SeaLife Center operates as a 501(c)(3) non-profit research institution and public aquarium in Seward, Alaska. The Center generates and shares scientific knowledge to promote understanding and stewardship of Alaska’s marine ecosystems. The ASLC is an accredited member of the Association of Zoos and Aquariums. To learn more, visit www.alaskasealife.org. ### Media Contact: [email protected] [email protected]

title: Photoroom vs Picsart: Which is better for e‑commerce in 2026?
summary: Compare Photoroom and Picsart side by side. Find out which tool is best for your product photos, e‑commerce visuals, or creative editing needs.
body_text: For e‑commerce sellers, choosing between Photoroom and Picsart comes down to one question: which tool improves product conversions? Both platforms offer background removal and editing features, but they're built for different goals. This comparison shows you exactly how each performs in real e‑commerce workflows so you can pick the one that turns your product photos into sales-driving assets faster. We'll break down exactly how each platform handles the workflows that matter: background removal, batch editing, AI automation, enterprise production, and export quality. You'll see which tool delivers the speed, consistency, and professional results that drive clicks and conversions. Key Takeaways Best for e‑commerce: Photoroom is specifically optimized for high-speed, consistent product listing preparation. Best for creative design: Picsart offers more flexibility for social media content, stickers, and artistic overlays. Best for enterprise: Photoroom’s production-ready AI stack is designed for e‑commerce teams looking to scale and improve visual production workflows Batch editing: Both support bulk edits, but at significantly different scales and workflows. PicsArt supports bulk edits for up to 100 images; Photoroom supports up to 250 with Pro plans, with a workflow tailored for marketplace catalogs. Pricing model: Photoroom Pro offers unlimited AI tool usage. Picsart uses a monthly AI credit system. Ease of use: Photoroom features a simplified UI for non-designers; Picsart has a steeper learning curve due to its extensive feature set. Photoroom vs. Picsart side-by-side comparison Photoroom and Picsart both offer image editing features, but only one is purpose-built for e‑commerce. Below, we compare how each platform performs across the areas that matter most for product photography Feature/Category Photoroom Picsart Core features Background removal, instant shadows, brand kit, e-commerce-focused UI Broad creative suite, templates for social/video, drawing tools, stickers Batch editing and workflow Batch edit up to 250 images with templates; optimized for speed and catalog consistency Batch edit up to 100 images; better for custom design variation AI tools and smart features AI backgrounds, shadows, expand, and enhancement; designed to automate listing prep AI Replace, text-to-image, style transfer; ideal for creative exploration Ease of use Simple, guided, and beginner-friendly. Fast onboarding and one-click tools to edit and improve product photos Rich UI with more tools and complexity; better for experienced creators Output and export options High-res JPG/PNG/WebP, transparent backgrounds, 250 free exports/month, no watermark JPG/PNG/WebP, transparent exports Pricing and plans Free plan available Pro: $12.99/month or $90/year Max: $34.99/month or $251.88/year Ultra: From $99/month or $990/year Free plan available Pro: $126/yr Ultra: $294/yr, per user licensing What is Photoroom? Photoroom is a photo editing tool built specifically for e‑commerce solo sellers and teams who need fast, professional product images. Custom workflows and flexible AI models create studio-quality product visuals in seconds, without the cost or delays of traditional photo shoots or design agencies. General-purpose editors force you to figure out marketplace specs yourself, but Photoroom's templates and AI tools are built specifically for e‑commerce standards, so your images are listing-ready from the start. Its core features—background removal, instant shadows, AI-generated backgrounds, and batch editing—are designed to simplify product listing prep for platforms like Shopify , Etsy, and Amazon . For enterprise teams, Photoroom’s API integrates AI-tools directly into visual content production workflows. Photoroom is available on iOS, Android, and web, with a simple interface that prioritizes speed and consistency over complex design flexibility. What is Picsart? Picsart is a creative editing platform offering a wide range of tools for photo and video editing, graphic design, and social media content creation. Popular with influencers, designers, and hobbyists, PicsArt combines AI-powered features like background removal and generative image tools with an extensive library of templates, stickers, fonts, and effects. Picsart serves creators focused on social content, digital art, and stylized marketing visuals—use cases that go beyond the product listing workflows that e‑commerce sellers prioritize. Core feature comparison Photoroom and Picsart’s features both cover the basics: background removal, cropping, and mobile-friendly editing. But their core strengths are tailored to very different workflows. Photoroom is optimized for e‑commerce tasks—excelling in creating fast, clean, consistent product images. And Picsart is built for creative versatility, from social content to full-blown design projects. Shared core features: AI-powered background removal Mobile and desktop editing Filters, crop/resize, and standard adjustments Access to templates (though for different purposes) Where Photoroom excels: Purpose-built for e‑commerce visuals Instant background removal with crisp, accurate cutouts Auto-generated shadows and white backgrounds Automatic image resizing for e‑commerce marketplaces and standard web sizes Clean UI designed for quick, repeatable product edits Advanced generative AI features to create new backgrounds and image compositions alongside your product image AI Expand , AI Upscale , and AI Retouch to enhance the quality of existing images “Photoroom is known for its AI-powered background removal feature, allowing me to easily and accurately remove backgrounds from photos. This provides me with a quick and efficient way to edit photos, particularly when it comes to background removal—the accuracy of background removal, makes the process smoother and more precise.” — ASHIKA B., G2 Review Where Picsart excels: Full creative suite beyond just product photos Thousands of design templates for social, video, and marketing Artistic tools like brushes, overlays, and stickers One-tap video tools and animated content features Strong fit for creators managing brand visuals beyond e‑commerce “I like that Picsart has so many templates and photo editing tools that help me in fixing, adjusting and helping to make my photos extra special. Great tools for photo editing for family photos and social media. The tools are very easy to utilize to implement what you need for your work.” — Angelo B., G2 Review Bottom line: For sellers focused on getting products online fast with professional, consistent results, Photoroom's e-commerce-first design has a clear advantage. Picsart offers more creative tools for stylized content, adding complexity that can slow down listing workflows. Batch editing and workflow speed If you're managing hundreds of product photos and listings, a product photo editor with bulk editing capabilities is a major time-saver. Both Photoroom and Picsart support batch editing, but they approach it differently in terms of scale, speed, automation, and use case alignment. Photoroom: built for speed and scale Batch editing is available on the Pro plan Edit up to 250 images at once with background removal, cropping, and templates (or consider Photoroom's API if you need to edit larger batches) Superior AI model maintains product accuracy across exports. Create custom templates to apply consistent branding and layouts Designed for e‑commerce workflows and perfect for updating product catalogs Saves you hours on creating consistent PDP (product detail page) images Picsart: capable but less e-commerce-specific Batch editing is available on the Pro plan Supports up to 50 images in a single batch, or 100 with the Ultra plan Can apply edits like crop, resize, background removal, and watermark Stronger for visual customization than standardized outputs Workflow can feel slower or less guided for marketplace prep Bottom line: Photoroom’s batch tools are tailored to e‑commerce needs, with templates and automation to speed up repetitive tasks at scale. Picsart can handle bulk edits too, but it’s better suited to creatives who want more control over design variation. AI tools and smart features Both Photoroom and PicsArt offer AI-driven tools, but their applications differ significantly. Photoroom's AI is trained on e‑commerce product photography, with tools that automate and improve output quality for visual production workflow. Picsart’s AI tools are used for visual creativity and artistic effects. Photoroom’s AI strengths: AI Backgrounds: Instantly generate photorealistic backgrounds tailored to product listings AI Shadows: Automatically adds realistic drop shadows to make products pop. AI Expand: Enlarges your image’s canvas without cropping or distortion. Product-first AI logic. Designed to improve listing quality, not just beautify images. Flexible model to generate the best results for any given task Picsart’s AI capabilities: AI Replace allows you to swap or modify objects in photos using text prompts. Text-to-image generation for stylized backgrounds or artistic assets. Style transfer and visual filters powered by generative AI. Offers more control for creating branded, highly stylized visuals. Bottom line: Photoroom’s AI automates listing prep and polishes product shots with minimal input. Picsart’s AI is more exploratory—with tools to experiment with style, composition, and design concepts. User experience and ease of use Usability matters; how easy a tool is to navigate and use can impact the return on your investment. Most e‑commerce sellers need professional-level tools without professional-level design knowledge. Photoroom: made for non-designers Clean, guided interface with minimal clutter Tools organized by e‑commerce use cases Automated sizing is available for e‑commerce marketplaces and standard web formats Sellers consistently report being able to edit their first batch of listings within minutes of signing up—no tutorial needed. Picsart: designed for creative flexibility Feature-rich UI with multiple menus and editing layers The extensive template library and design options require more time to navigate, which can slow down high-volume listing workflows. Great for those familiar with design workflows or social media editing Users appreciate the customization, but some report “lag” or decision fatigue Bottom line: For sellers who need to get products online quickly and maintain consistent quality across hundreds of listings, Photoroom's streamlined interface allows for frictionless workflows on web and mobile. Output quality and export options Your export quality determines whether your listings look professional or amateur—and whether buyers trust you enough to click 'add to cart.' Photoroom: optimized for e‑commerce output High-resolution exports in JPG, PNG, and WebP formats Transparent background support on all plans Free plan includes 250 monthly exports with no watermark Pro plan removes all watermarking and unlocks unlimited exports Fixed and custom sizing options to instantly re-size for e‑commerce marketplaces and standard web formats Resizing is available for single exports and batch exports (for Pro users) Import photos from Dropbox, Google Drive, iCloud, and OneDrive Ability to save to your gallery, share a link to the image, or send the image from your device Picsart: creative flexibility with cloud storage Exports in JPG, PNG, and WebP formats Transparent background exports are available on all plans No watermark on free exports, but AI usage and export features are limited Cloud storage included (5GB for Plus, 20GB for Pro) Better for mixed media (e.g., social posts, print files, video frames) Bottom line: Photoroom delivers marketplace-ready images out of the box, with export options and sizes aligned to e‑commerce platforms. The platform also makes it easy to save and share your images in a few clicks, so your team can access them across devices . Picsart offers the same level of versatility across media types and offers cloud storage capabilities, but may require more manual tweaking to hit e‑commerce standards. Photoroom vs Picsart for Enterprise teams For enterprise teams with large product catalogs, the difference between API tools often comes down to workflow: how easily can I use this tool to automate, scale, and improve visual production? E‑commerce teams may prefer Photoroom for its customizable workflows and e-commerce-trained tools that speed up production without sacrificing quality. PicsArt’s API offers similar and additional creative editing tools, but without the same customizable, end-to-end workflows. Photoroom: E‑commerce focused APIs Production-ready AI-stack designed for e‑commerce Automates custom visual production workflows end-to-end Preserves exact product accuracy while enforcing strict brand and/or marketplace compliance AI uses the best model for the task at hand to create superior results Batch processing for large catalogs Faster time-to-market with lower engineering and design overheads Agile team offering PicsArt: Creative editing at scale Templated workflows based on popular use cases Automate a variety of tools for creative editing: text, stickers, and templates Integrates into content-sharing apps like WordPress and Instagram Flexible AI model Bottom line: Photoroom’s API is the only complete solution for e‑commerce teams looking to scale visual production with consistent, high-quality outputs that adhere to strict brand or marketplace rules. For influencers, social media teams, or design agencies, PicsArt’s API can help scale asset creation with a variety of creative tools and templates. For more information on Photoroom’s API, contact the sales team . Pricing and plans Both platforms offer free plans and paid tiers, but use different pricing models for AI usage. Photoroom's pricing includes unlimited AI usage to help maintain speed and scale in product photography workflows. With unlimited AI, you can test and reuse features for one monthly fee. PicsArt offers AI features through monthly credits—once you run out, you won’t be able to use AI features. How much does Photoroom cost? Photoroom offers a free trial to all users. The following prices apply after the trial period: Plan Cost Pro $7.50 per month/billed annually $12.99 per month/billed monthly Max $20.99 per month/billed annually $34.99 per month/billed monthly Ultra From $82.50 per month/billed annually From $99 per month/billed monthly Enterprise Contact the sales team You can find more information about what each plan includes on the dedicated pricing page . How much does Picsart cost? Plan Features Cost Free Basic photo/video editing, 5 AI credits per week, 100MB cloud storage Free Pro 500 AI credits/month, premium content library, up to 50 bulk edits, 100GB cloud storage $10.50/month (billed annually) Ultra 2500 AI credits/month, unlimited background removals, up to 100 bulk edits, 300GB storage/seat $24.50/month (billed annually) For solo sellers and small teams, Photoroom delivers more e-commerce-specific features at a lower cost, and without the monthly credit caps that limit how many listings you can prep. Use cases for Photoroom and Picsart Choosing between Photoroom and Picsart comes down to what you're actually trying to accomplish: get products online faster or create stylized brand content. If you manage e‑commerce product listings across marketplaces like Etsy, Amazon, or Shopify, Photoroom consistently delivers faster, more reliable results. Photoroom’s tools are built to streamline high-volume editing, from batch background removal to branded templates that fit platform specs out of the box. If your workflow involves prepping large collections of SKUs or maintaining a consistent visual identity across listings, you’ll find Photoroom’s speed and e‑commerce focus valuable. Picsart, by contrast, is a better fit for creators who prioritize social content and brand storytelling. Influencers, designers, and marketers who want more control over layout, text overlays, video, and creative effects will find its features more flexible, but more complex. If you're managing product listings, Photoroom removes the bottlenecks that slow down workflows—so you spend less time editing and more time selling. If you're promoting a lifestyle or building a visual brand across channels, Picsart gives you more freedom to design, with a more hands-on process. Photoroom vs Picsart: Use case performance We’ve compared each tool against the features and capabilities required by these popular use cases. Use case Photoroom Picsart Solo e‑commerce seller prepping listings ✅ Optimized for speed, background removal, and clean product visuals ❌ Overkill; tools may distract from listing-focused tasks Marketplace seller with high photo volume ✅ Batch editing for 250+ SKUs; product templates, and fast exports ⚠ Supports 100 batch edits and lacks e-commerce-focused automation Small brand managing product imagery and ads ✅ Great for consistent PDP images, basic ad formats, and quick branding ✅ Better for stylized content and marketing visuals with custom assets Social-first content creator or influencer ⚠ Limited design/sticker/text features; better for product close-ups ✅ Thousands of creative tools, effects, stickers, and social templates Creative agency or designer creating mixed assets ⚠Limited advanced layouts, multi-step edits, or video ✅ Strong fit for multi-channel campaigns and advanced visuals Non-designer who wants fast, intuitive tools ✅ Clean UI, guided templates, minimal setup needed ⚠ Rich features but steeper learning curve Teams or small businesses with shared workflows ✅ $89.99/yr includes 3 seats, shared templates, and brand kits ❌ Requires individual licenses for each user; higher total cost; users are constrained by monthly AI credit limits Enterprise teams scaling visual production ✅API and team features that speed up workflows without losing accuracy; automations designed for e‑commerce ⚠ API offers some e‑commerce features but no custom workflows; better for marketing design teams Photoroom vs. PicsArt: Which tool fits the needs of e‑commerce sellers? Both Photoroom and Picsart are powerful tools, but they serve different goals. When choosing between Photoroom and PicsArt, consider your workflows. What tasks do you need an AI photo editor for? If your priority is creating high-quality product images quickly, Photoroom’s e-commerce-first design makes it the clear choice. With batch editing, marketplace-ready templates, and AI tools that streamline listing prep, it’s built to save you time without sacrificing image quality. Picsart is built for influencers, marketers, and designers who prioritize creative flexibility over consistent, listing-ready visuals—making it less practical for sellers managing high-volume product catalogs. For creating professional, consistent product images across hundreds of listings, Photoroom is the best choice. Try Photoroom today on the App Store or Google Play . Frequently asked questions Does Photoroom reduce image quality? Photoroom keeps your original resolution for most photos. If the file is larger than our current 24-megapixel limit, we automatically resize it so it downloads quickly. Photorom will never automatically upscale images during the export process. Learn more . Is Photoroom free to use? Yes. Our free plan includes background removal, core AI tools, and 250 watermark-free exports each month. Upgrade to a paid plan anytime for unlimited exports, Batch Mode, and team features. See plan details . How many images can I batch edit at once in Photoroom? Batch Mode lets you process up to 250 images at a time on the Pro plan. For larger volumes, use the Photoroom API to automate bulk editing. Learn about Batch Mode .

Women in STEM
body_text: Women in STEM Uzbekistan is determined to become a regional IT hub, to define itself through its digital skills and development of STEM – science, technology, engineering and mathematics. This strategy is not just powering its strong economy, with 5.3% GDP growth per annum , but also driving positive social change. Munisa Rakhimjonova is an expert in big data with VEON AdTech in Tashkent. Her journey into information technology reflects the opportunities that the digital transformation is creating in Central Asia. Western nations have seen the IT profession develop as a very male dominated environment. Only 11.2% of computer programmers are female, which is ironic as research by GitHub found that code written by women was approved at a higher rate (78.6%) than code written by men (74.6%). A large part of the problem is that women and girls are frequently deterred from even considering IT as a career: a global OECD study found that just 1% of 15 year old girls want to work as ICT professional, compared to 5.5% of boys. In Uzbekistan the reverse is often true, with jobs in programming and big data analytics being seen by some women as offering opportunities for greater inclusivity in the workplace. “I don't think that we have any discrimination against women in the IT sector in Uzbekistan,” explains Munisa Rakhimjonova. “In fact, in VEON AdTech I can confirm that the majority of IT leaders and product owners are female.” Munisa started her journey into IT at school as she saw the opportunities it presented. Studying Information Technologies in Business at Tashkent University, she went on to obtain degrees and qualifications in Latvia and Austria before returning to Uzbekistan to start her career. Today, Munisa leads teams of data analysts and programmers in Tashkent and she is the embodiment of a young, smart and technically savvy Uzbek IT specialist. Her recent projects have included an analysis of sales patterns for a global mobile handset brand to identify market opportunities, and the determination of optimum location and services for a bank. In other career paths, Munisa may have encountered more traditional structures that place men at the forefront of business and decision making. Instead, Munisa is following her chosen career in an egalitarian environment in a company with strong female leadership. Munisa’s experience mirrors that of thousands of women in Uzbekistan who have found their vocation in IT. Both Beeline Uzbekistan and VEON AdTech have prioritised equality in the workplace in line with the Government’s “National Strategy for Achieving Gender Equality in Uzbekistan”. Women constitute 36% of all employees at Beeline and 40% of its senior management, while at VEON AdTech, which comprises mainly digital and IT specialists, the male-to-female ratio is 70:30. Beeline Uzbekistan, has also run programmes to support female IT entrepreneurs as part of a project called Tumaris.Tech that brings together women working and doing business in the field of IT across Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Turkmenistan. This culminated in a hackathon event that brought together 500 young female developers from across Central Asia. The focus on gender equality also supports Uzbekistan’s ambition to be a regional IT hub. Under the Government’s leadership, both the public and private sector have put substantial effort and resources into the country’s IT prowess. This has included the opening of the IT Park in Tashkent to create a critical mass of IT talent in a single location, and it is now the home base of Beeline Uzbekistan. Another significant initiative in the country has been the establishment of the Astrum Academy which trains young talent in programming and big data analytics. Munisa and her peers – male and female – are ready to take on the next set of challenges to make Uzbekistan’s ambitions come true, using emerging technologies extensively to produce local data-driven solutions, benefiting the people who generate the data. As Munisa explains, “I always say that I love data because through it, we can see clearly. Data provides insights into the trends and current situation of any business. We can gain knowledge by using machine learning, AI and other techniques. Data enables us to predict the future and help businesses reduce their risks. Which is really cool.” Munisa’s journey reflects the wider movement across Central Asia; one that is more egalitarian, digitally focused and highly ambitious. Not only is this rendering an economic change, it is also causing a societal evolution as well. “I'm from a patriarchal culture, where the decisions of men used to dictate the lives of women,” explains Munisa. “But that is no longer the case when you are working in IT in Uzbekistan; we are building the future and widening civilization as we use IT and data in all aspects of life. With data and IT the young women of today have been given the freedom to decide for themselves and contribute to the society in ways that were simply not available to women before,.”

body_text: PGM Solutions Expands Home Factors with New Roof and Electrical Insights to Strengthen Carrier Risk Models New attributes—electrical panel location, roof life stage, and plumbing materials—enhance underwriting precision and deepen visibility into structural risk. Tampa, FL – October 14, 2025 — PGM Solutions today announced the expansion of its Home Factors property intelligence platform. The latest release introduces several new and enhanced attributes, including electrical panel and sub-panel location, roof life stage segmentation, and updated plumbing material indicators. These additions bring the platform closer to its goal of offering over 100 property attributes, covering nearly 90% of U.S. homes. Home Factors provides interior and exterior attributes and condition data to help carriers improve underwriting, pricing, and risk selection. Collectively, these newly released attributes offer deeper visibility into critical home systems- supporting stronger risk models and more accurate decisioning. Electrical Panel Location: Offers insight into where a home’s electrical systems are situated, helping carriers assess potential fire and maintenance risks. Roof Life Stage: Segments roofs by age and expected remaining lifespan, enabling more precise risk stratification. Plumbing Material Indicators: Flags the presence of PVC in inlet pipes and CPVC in outlet pipes, which can signal long-term durability or risk concerns. “These new Home Factors continue our momentum in transforming how carriers assess risk,” said Matt Ehrlichman, Founder, Chairman and CEO of Porch Group. “We’re building a platform that delivers measurable ROI today while setting a new standard for property intelligence in the years ahead.” For more information, visit: https://insurance.pgmsolutions.com About Home Factors Home Factors, powered by PGM Solutions, delivers advanced property intelligence that gives insurers a clearer view of risk, inside and out. By combining exclusive access to over 90% of U.S. homebuyers with rich exterior and interior property attributes, Home Factors enables carriers, MGAs, and reinsurers to make faster, more precise underwriting and pricing decisions. With insights into foundation condition, window condition, electrical systems, water intrusion, piping, and more, Home Factors provides the depth and clarity needed to lower loss ratios and drive profitable growth. For more information, visit: https://HomeFactors.com or https://insurance.pgmsolutions.com .

title: 7 Rekomendasi Aplikasi Stok Barang Terbaik untuk Bisnis
summary: Temukan aplikasi stok barang terbaik untuk mengelola, meningkatkan efisiensi dan memantau persediaan secara real-time pada bisnis.
body_text: Rekomendasi Aplikasi Stok Barang Terbaik untuk Bisnis Jubelio Aplikasi Stok Barang Mengelola stok barang sering terlihat sederhana ketika jumlah produk dan transaksi masih sedikit. Namun, seiring bisnis berkembang, pencatatan barang masuk dan keluar menjadi semakin kompleks Selisih stok, produk habis tanpa terdeteksi, penumpukan barang, hingga pesanan yang harus dibatalkan dapat terjadi apabila persediaan masih dikelola secara manual. Tantangan tersebut semakin besar ketika bisnis mempunyai banyak SKU, gudang, cabang, serta berjualan melalui marketplace, website, dan toko offline secara bersamaan. Tanpa data persediaan yang terpusat, tim akan kesulitan mengetahui jumlah stok sebenarnya dan memperbarui ketersediaan produk pada setiap channel penjualan. Karena itu, aplikasi stok barang dibutuhkan untuk membantu bisnis memantau persediaan, mencatat pergerakan produk, mengelola banyak gudang, serta menyediakan laporan. Apa itu Sistem Aplikasi Stok Barang? Aplikasi stok barang adalah sistem digital yang digunakan untuk mencatat, memantau, dan mengelola persediaan produk dalam suatu bisnis. Melalui aplikasi ini, perusahaan dapat mengetahui jumlah stok yang tersedia, barang yang masuk dan keluar, lokasi penyimpanan, hingga riwayat perubahan stok secara lebih terstruktur. Penggunaan aplikasi stok barang membantu bisnis menggantikan proses pencatatan manual yang biasanya dilakukan melalui buku atau spreadsheet. Setiap terjadi transaksi pembelian dari supplier, penjualan kepada pelanggan, retur, transfer antar gudang, dan penyesuaian stok, dapat langsung tercatat di dalam sistem. Pada bisnis yang memiliki banyak produk, gudang, toko, atau kanal penjualan, aplikasi stok barang berperan sebagai pusat informasi persediaan. Data stok dari toko offline, marketplace, website, dan gudang dapat dikelola dalam satu sistem agar jumlah persediaan tetap akurat dan mudah dipantau. Fungsi dari Aplikasi Stok Barang Bagi Bisnis Berikut beberapa fungsi utama dari penggunaan aplikasi stok barang: 1. Mencatat Barang Masuk dan Keluar Setiap aktivitas penerimaan dan pengeluaran barang dapat dicatat melalui sistem. Barang masuk dapat berasal dari pembelian supplier, retur pelanggan, atau transfer dari gudang lain. Sementara itu, barang keluar dapat berasal dari penjualan, retur ke supplier, barang rusak, maupun transfer antar lokasi. Pencatatan ini membantu bisnis mengetahui penyebab setiap perubahan jumlah persediaan. 2. Memantau Stok secara Real-Time Aplikasi stok barang dapat memperbarui jumlah persediaan setelah terjadi transaksi. Tim operasional tidak perlu menunggu laporan manual untuk mengetahui stok yang tersedia di gudang atau toko. Informasi yang lebih aktual membantu bisnis mengurangi risiko menjual barang yang sebenarnya sudah habis. 3. Mengurangi Risiko Selisih Stok Selisih antara stok yang tercatat dan stok fisik dapat terjadi akibat kesalahan input, barang hilang, kerusakan, transaksi yang belum tercatat, atau proses operasional yang kurang terkontrol. Melalui pencatatan riwayat transaksi dan penyesuaian stok, bisnis dapat menelusuri penyebab selisih dengan lebih mudah. 4. Memberikan Notifikasi Stok Menipis Aplikasi dapat memberikan pemberitahuan ketika jumlah persediaan mencapai batas minimum yang telah ditentukan. Tim pembelian dapat segera melakukan pemesanan ulang sebelum produk benar-benar habis. 5. Mengelola Stok di Banyak Gudang atau Cabang Bisnis yang mempunyai beberapa gudang, toko, atau cabang dapat memantau persediaan dari satu sistem. Jumlah stok pada setiap lokasi dapat dilihat secara terpisah maupun secara keseluruhan. Tim juga dapat mencatat perpindahan barang antar gudang agar distribusi persediaan menjadi lebih merata. 6. Mendukung Proses Stock Opname Stock opname dilakukan untuk membandingkan jumlah stok fisik dengan data yang tercatat di dalam sistem. Aplikasi stok barang membantu proses penghitungan, pencatatan hasil, identifikasi selisih, dan penyesuaian persediaan. 7. Mengetahui Riwayat Pergerakan Barang Setiap perubahan persediaan dapat disimpan dalam riwayat transaksi. Bisnis dapat mengetahui kapan barang masuk, kapan terjual, siapa yang melakukan perubahan, serta alasan dilakukannya penyesuaian stok. Riwayat tersebut dapat digunakan sebagai audit trail untuk meningkatkan kontrol dan akuntabilitas operasional. 8. Mencegah Kekurangan dan Kelebihan Stok Kekurangan stok dapat menyebabkan pesanan tidak terpenuhi, sedangkan kelebihan stok dapat meningkatkan biaya penyimpanan dan risiko barang tidak terjual. Aplikasi stok barang membantu bisnis menentukan jumlah persediaan yang lebih seimbang berdasarkan data penjualan, stok minimum, waktu pengadaan, dan tren permintaan. 9. Mempercepat Pemrosesan Pesanan Data stok yang terhubung dengan proses penjualan membantu tim mengetahui barang yang tersedia untuk diproses. Pesanan dapat diteruskan ke tahap pengambilan, pengemasan, dan pengiriman tanpa harus melakukan pengecekan stok secara manual berulang kali. 10. Menyediakan Laporan Persediaan Aplikasi stok barang dapat menghasilkan berbagai laporan seperti laporan stok tersedia, barang masuk dan keluar, produk terlaris, stok mati, nilai persediaan, serta selisih stock opname. Laporan tersebut membantu manajemen mengevaluasi kondisi persediaan dan mengambil keputusan berdasarkan data. Kenapa Bisnis di Era Modern Perlu Aplikasi Stok Barang? Di era modern, bisnis dituntut untuk bergerak lebih cepat, akurat, dan responsif terhadap perubahan permintaan pasar. Pengelolaan stok secara manual sering kali tidak lagi memadai, apalagi ketika jumlah produk, transaksi, gudang, dan channel penjualan terus bertambah. Berikut beberapa alasan mengapa penggunaannya semakin dibutuhkan: 1. Volume Transaksi Semakin Besar Ketika bisnis berkembang, jumlah barang masuk dan keluar akan semakin banyak. Pencatatan menggunakan buku atau spreadsheet dapat menyulitkan tim dalam memperbarui data secara konsisten. Aplikasi stok barang membantu mencatat setiap pergerakan persediaan secara lebih sistematis sehingga risiko transaksi terlewat dapat ditekan. 2. Bisnis Menjual di Banyak Channel Saat ini, bisnis dapat menjual produk melalui marketplace, website, media sosial, toko offline, dan kanal lainnya. Setiap kanal dapat menghasilkan transaksi pada waktu yang hampir bersamaan. Tanpa sistem yang terintegrasi, jumlah stok pada setiap kanal berisiko berbeda. Aplikasi stok barang membantu memperbarui persediaan agar data yang digunakan tetap konsisten. 3. Keputusan Bisnis Perlu Didukung Data Pengadaan barang tidak seharusnya hanya bergantung pada perkiraan. Bisnis membutuhkan data untuk mengetahui produk yang cepat terjual, lambat bergerak, sering habis, atau terlalu lama tersimpan. Aplikasi stok barang menyediakan laporan yang dapat digunakan untuk merencanakan pembelian dan menentukan jumlah persediaan yang lebih sesuai dengan kebutuhan. 4. Risiko Human Error Semakin Tinggi Semakin banyak transaksi yang dikelola secara manual, semakin besar pula kemungkinan terjadi kesalahan input, pencatatan ganda, atau perubahan data yang tidak terdokumentasi. Aplikasi membantu mengotomatisasi sebagian proses pencatatan sekaligus menyimpan riwayat perubahan stok agar kesalahan lebih mudah ditemukan dan ditelusuri. 5. Bisnis Membutuhkan Informasi secara Real-Time Data stok yang terlambat diperbarui dapat mempengaruhi keputusan pembelian, penjualan, dan pemenuhan pesanan. Tim mungkin mengira barang masih tersedia, padahal stok sebenarnya sudah habis. Melalui aplikasi, jumlah persediaan dapat diperbarui setelah transaksi terjadi sehingga tim mendapatkan informasi yang lebih aktual. 6. Mendukung Pertumbuhan Bisnis Sistem manual mungkin masih dapat digunakan ketika jumlah produk dan transaksi masih terbatas. Namun, cara tersebut akan semakin sulit dipertahankan seiring pertumbuhan bisnis. Aplikasi stok barang menyediakan fondasi operasional yang lebih siap untuk menangani peningkatan pesanan, penambahan produk, perluasan gudang, dan pembukaan kanal penjualan baru. Rekomendasi Aplikasi Stok Barang Terbaik dan Populer 1. Jubelio (Paling Direkomendasikan) Jubelio merupakan aplikasi omnichannel yang cocok untuk bisnis yang menjual produk melalui berbagai channel seperti marketplace, website, toko offline, dan gudang. Melalui satu dashboard, bisnis dapat menyinkronkan persediaan dari berbagai channel penjualan dan lokasi penyimpanan. Selain manajemen stok, Jubelio mempunyai sistem Warehouse Management System atau WMS untuk membantu mengelola operasional gudang termasuk proses penerimaan, penyimpanan, pengambilan, pengemasan, dan pemantauan kinerja operasional. Fitur utama stok barang Jubelio: Sinkronisasi Stok dan Multi Gudang Perbarui jumlah persediaan secara otomatis di seluruh marketplace, webstore, dan toko fisik setiap kali terjadi transaksi. Ketersediaan barang dari berbagai gudang juga dapat dipantau dalam satu sistem, sehingga bisnis lebih mudah mengatur distribusi stok, mengurangi risiko overselling, dan mencegah penumpukan barang di lokasi tertentu. Pengelolaan Produk Terpusat Kelola informasi produk seperti nama, deskripsi, harga, varian, dan promosi melalui satu dashboard. Setiap perubahan dapat diterapkan ke berbagai toko secara lebih cepat, sehingga katalog tetap konsisten dan tim tidak perlu melakukan pembaruan berulang di masing-masing channel. Pemrosesan Pesanan Omnichannel Kumpulkan pesanan dari marketplace, website ecommerce, dan channel penjualan lainnya ke dalam satu alur kerja. Tim dapat memeriksa detail order, memproses pesanan, mencetak label, hingga memantau status pengiriman melalui satu sistem yang sama. Sistem Manajemen Gudang Terintegrasi Pantau aktivitas gudang mulai dari penerimaan barang, penyimpanan, perpindahan stok, picking, packing, hingga pengiriman. Sistem WMS memberikan visibilitas yang lebih jelas terhadap lokasi barang dan progres pekerjaan tim. Integrasi POS dan Website Ecommerce Satukan transaksi dari toko fisik, webstore, dan channel online lainnya dalam satu ekosistem. Data penjualan dan stok dapat diperbarui secara terpusat, sehingga bisnis memperoleh gambaran performa online dan offline secara menyeluruh. Laporan Penjualan dan Keuangan Pantau omset, produk terlaris, performa marketplace, biaya, margin, dan kontribusi setiap channel melalui laporan yang tersusun secara otomatis. Data transaksi yang terhubung dengan pembukuan membantu bisnis memahami sumber keuntungan, menemukan biaya yang perlu dikendalikan, serta menentukan strategi penjualan berdasarkan kondisi aktual. Dengan fitur yang sangat lengkap, Jubelio menjadi salah satu rekomendasi aplikasi stok barang yang terbaik dan gratis . Kalau penasaran dengan fiturnya, kamu bisa coba Jubelio secara GRATIS sekarang juga! 2. Accurate Online Accurate Online merupakan software akuntansi dan bisnis yang dilengkapi fitur pengelolaan persediaan. Sistem ini membantu bisnis memantau stok, melakukan stock opname, mengelola beberapa gudang, serta mencatat pergerakan barang. Accurate juga mendukung perhitungan persediaan menggunakan metode FIFO dan Average. Pergerakan stok dapat langsung terhubung dengan pencatatan harga pokok dan laporan keuangan bisnis. 3. Majoo Majoo dikenal sebagai aplikasi bisnis dan kasir yang ditujukan untuk UMKM, retail, kuliner, dan bisnis dengan beberapa outlet. Selain fitur point of sale, Majoo menyediakan pengelolaan inventori, akuntansi, analisis bisnis, CRM, dan manajemen karyawan. Pada bagian inventori, bisnis dapat mencatat barang masuk dan keluar, memantau stok per gudang, membuat laporan, menetapkan stok minimum, serta menerima notifikasi ketika barang mulai menipis. 4. Odoo Inventory Odoo Inventory merupakan bagian dari ekosistem aplikasi bisnis Odoo. Sistem ini menggabungkan fungsi pengelolaan inventory dan warehouse serta dapat dihubungkan dengan modul penjualan, pembelian, manufaktur, akuntansi, dan aplikasi Odoo lainnya Odoo mendukung penggunaan barcode untuk produk dan kemasan, pencatatan pergerakan barang, penyesuaian persediaan, serta integrasi melalui API dengan perangkat maupun layanan pihak ketiga. 5. Zoho Inventory Zoho Inventory merupakan aplikasi pengelolaan stok dan pesanan berbasis cloud yang ditujukan untuk bisnis yang sedang berkembang. Sistemnya mendukung pengelolaan pesanan online dan offline, purchase order, backorder, dropship, serta integrasi dengan beberapa platform e-commerce. Zoho Inventory juga menyediakan pelacakan nomor seri dan batch, pengelolaan beberapa gudang, vendor, laporan persediaan, serta integrasi dengan aplikasi lain dalam ekosistem Zoho. 6. inFlow Inventory inFlow Inventory merupakan software yang berfokus pada pengelolaan stok, pesanan, penjualan, pembelian, barcode, dan proses manufaktur. Sistem ini dapat diakses melalui web, Windows, iPhone, dan perangkat Android. inFlow juga menyediakan katalog B2B untuk bisnis grosir serta alur penjualan yang mencakup pembuatan penawaran, pemenuhan pesanan, invoice, pembayaran, dan retur. 7. Sortly Sortly merupakan aplikasi inventory berbasis cloud dan mobile yang berfokus pada kemudahan pencatatan barang, aset, perlengkapan, material, dan peralatan. Fitur yang tersedia mencakup barcode atau QR code, notifikasi stok minimum, laporan, pencatatan dari perangkat seluler, serta pengelolaan persediaan pada beberapa lokasi. Sortly juga menyediakan kemampuan bekerja secara offline. Perubahan yang dilakukan saat perangkat tidak terhubung ke internet akan disinkronkan kembali setelah koneksi tersedia. Sortly lebih berfokus pada pelacakan barang dan aset. Bisnis perlu mengevaluasi kembali apabila membutuhkan integrasi marketplace, akuntansi lokal, atau pemrosesan pesanan yang lebih kompleks.
